chapters.title: RAG: separate retrieval from generation
chapters.description: Follow a RAG query through retrieval, eligibility, reranking, context assembly, and generation, and separate index accuracy from useful evidence.

chapters.title: ANN methods: define the target before choosing the index
chapters.description: Define the exact neighbor task before choosing an ANN index, compare cosine, inner product, and L2, and separate candidate discovery from score approximation.

chapters.title: HNSW: take a detour to find the nearest neighbor
chapters.description: Start with a four-vector routing puzzle, replay the HNSW search, and follow checked examples through hierarchy, graph construction, native tuning, and RAG filters.

chapters.title: HNSW graphs: why the hierarchy changes the route
chapters.learning_question: Why start in a tiny graph when the answer lives below?
chapters.description: Derive HNSW's nested graph levels and promotion probabilities, trace greedy descent, and distinguish expected hierarchy height from actual query complexity.

chapters.title: HNSW search: trace both heaps before changing ef
chapters.learning_question: Why does keeping three candidates find what one candidate misses?
chapters.description: Trace HNSW layer search with its candidate min-heap, retained max-heap, visited set, pruning rule, and stopping condition on a fully checked routing example.

chapters.title: Build HNSW: choose routes, not just nearby neighbors
chapters.learning_question: Why keep a farther neighbor instead of the closest pair?
chapters.description: Follow HNSW insertion, calculate the diversity heuristic, separate M from adjacency caps, and inspect how reciprocal linking and local pruning affect the graph.

chapters.title: Tune HNSW: recall, latency, and memory under one workload
chapters.learning_question: When does exact search beat the graph?
chapters.description: Compare measured HNSW operating points with an exact flat baseline, explain M and ef settings, estimate memory, and reproduce the declared native-index workload.

chapters.title: HNSW in RAG: filters, updates, and evidence quality
chapters.learning_question: How can an exact shortlist become empty after filtering?
chapters.description: Define filtered exact neighbors, distinguish routing from result eligibility, verify native filter/deletion behavior, and diagnose where ANN misses affect a RAG answer.

chapters.title: Hierarchical k-means and trees: split the space and merge a forest
chapters.learning_question: Why does one partition tree miss a neighbor right across the split?
chapters.description: Trace hierarchical k-means branch-and-bound routing, random-projection hyperplane splits in Annoy, priority-queue inspection budgets, and why merging a forest of trees repairs boundary misses.

chapters.title: IVF: partition into Voronoi cells and probe the nearest lists
chapters.learning_question: Why can the nearest centroid hide the nearest vector?
chapters.description: Construct a Voronoi partition with coarse k-means centroids, trace why nprobe=1 misses a neighbor across a cell boundary, derive residual vectors, and quantify posting-list imbalance.

chapters.title: Product quantization: split subspaces and score with lookup tables
chapters.learning_question: How can 64 thousand centroids be searched without storing 64 thousand vectors?
chapters.description: Decompose vectors into M orthogonal subspaces, build Cartesian-product codebooks, compute asymmetric distances with precomputed lookup tables, and combine coarse cells with residual PQ in IVFPQ.

chapters.title: Scalar and binary quantization: compress coordinates and rerank the shortlist
chapters.learning_question: When does a 1-bit sign check preserve the top-K neighborhood?
chapters.description: Compare uniform int8/int4 scalar quantization and 1-bit binary Hamming distance, trace quantization distortion on inner products and L2, and recover exact order with oversampled full-precision reranking.
chapters.series: RAG · ANN Methods · Scalar & Binary Quantization

chapters.title: LSH: turn angular similarity into hash collisions
chapters.learning_question: How do random hyperplanes find near neighbors without learning the data?
chapters.description: Derive the random-hyperplane collision probability from the angle between vectors, shape the S-curve with K-bit hashes and L tables, and compare multi-probe LSH against learned partitions.

chapters.title: ScaNN: weight parallel quantization error for inner-product search
chapters.learning_question: Why does smaller Euclidean reconstruction error pick the wrong inner-product neighbor?
chapters.description: Decompose quantization error into parallel and orthogonal components, derive ScaNN's anisotropic objective for maximum inner-product search, and verify on a worked example where isotropic quantization flips the winner.

chapters.title: DiskANN and Vamana: route with RAM codes and fetch vectors from SSD
chapters.learning_question: How do you search a billion-vector graph when the vectors do not fit in RAM?
chapters.description: Contrast Vamana's single-layer alpha-pruned graph with multi-layer HNSW, calculate the alpha-occlusion rule on a detour triangle, and trace how DiskANN pairs RAM-resident PQ routing with single-read SSD hops.
